title: Finiteness of the solution set of a linear matrix equation
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite field, and let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers. Fix a codeword $v : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \alpha$ of length $n$ and a codeword $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,k \to \alpha$ of length $k$. Then the set of matrices $G \in \alpha^{n \times k}$ satisfying $Gx = v$ is finite.
hypotheses_covered: fixed codeword v of length n
fixed codeword x of length k
replaced: For fixed $x\in\alpha^k$ and $v\in\alpha^n$, the set $\{G : Gx=v\}$ is finite.
